description: Find who to ask about a specific job: the hiring manager when JobGPT is confident, otherwise a peer who could refer you. slot ('hiring_manager' or 'referral') says which. If nobody is found the call fails with a not-found message; if the lookup fails, try again in a minute.

jobId.description: The job ID to find referrers for

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default: 2, max: 2)

name: get_job_referrers
